I can't give you an amount on that one. Scoop sizes and what's in them vary a lot from product to product, and the right dose depends on you. A doctor or a registered dietitian is the person to ask, and the label on your specific product is the place to start.

What I can tell you is that most pre-workouts lean on caffeine, which is worth knowing if you're sensitive to it or training late in the day, since it can eat into your sleep. If you tell me when you train and how your sessions have been feeling, I can talk through the training side, like warm-ups and timing.
